Secret Documents

Documents found in the abandoned bunker's archive. Time and damp have claimed almost every record stored here. Only a few survived. The bunker is the final chapter of the STATIC game where the player is going to face the Operator.

Classified — Internal Circulation

Institute No. ██ — Applied Radiophysics Section

Date: 14 MAR 1983  ·  Ref: ██/83-112  ·  [translated from the original]

Subject: Interim report — extended-band search trials, series “K”

1. Under the approved programme, the Section conducted nine trial sessions extending receiver sweep below the conventional search floor of ██ kHz. Sessions 1 through 7 returned atmospheric noise consistent with the reference model.

2. Session 8 (duration 6 hrs 12 min, dense fog over the array) registered a structured emission at ████ Hz, persisting 41 minutes. The emission exhibits periodic amplitude flicker not attributable to any catalogued source, natural or artificial.

3. Attention is drawn to the following: the emission’s structure suggests modulated content. Playback was authorized for a limited group. Findings of the playback session are reported separately under ref. ██/83-119.

4. The Section requests continuation of series “K” with extended session durations, and assignment of a dedicated operator staff. Fog-correlated scheduling is recommended.

Section Head — ████████  ·  4 copies typed, 3rd copy

Classified

Directorate ██ — Incident Commission

Date: 02 NOV 1984  ·  Ref: ██/84-006  ·  [translated from the original]

Subject: Findings on the incident involving intercept operator Sgt. ████████ ██.

1. Sgt. ████████ ██., assigned to playback duty under series “K” since JUN 1983, logged a cumulative ███ hours of exposure to the emission designated ██/83-119. Duty logs for the final month are attached. Entries after 04 OCT consist of a single repeated phrase and are attached separately.

2. On the night of 11 OCT the Sgt. ████████ ██. was found at his station. The receiving equipment was powered on. The equipment had been disconnected from its antenna since 09 OCT for scheduled maintenance.

3. As to the Sgt. ████████ ██. condition and subsequent events, the Commission established the following:

███████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ █████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ ████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ ██████████████████████████████████████████ [content withdrawn at declassification review; no copy retained]

4. The Commission recommends that operator staffing under series “K” be ████████████, and that the question of continued playback be referred upward. The Commission notes that it was not the first to make this recommendation.
